title: Prognostic Significance of Fine-Needle Aspiration Cytology Features in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the relationship between prognosis and fine needle aspiration cytology character of papillary thyroid cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Papillary thyroid cancer diagnosed in NTUH from 1977 to 2000

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient without complete medical record
